{{Quote|Welcome to Coruscant. How may I help you?|Tourist Director to Captain Panaka|audio=TouristDirector.flac|<ref name="TPMVG" />}}
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] served as the '''Tourist Director''' of the [[Tourist Center]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], [[King/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and her [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]] demanded that the [[Tourist Director]] allowed them to access to the company [[Comlink/Legends|comlinks]]. They wished to contact the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] for assistance after escaping an assassination attempt.<ref name="TPMVG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Tourist Director resembled [[Agrippa Aldrete/Legends|Agrippa Aldrete]], a character whose scenes were cut from [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="TPM cut">{{Film|I}}, deleted scene featured on the Blu-ray edition.</ref>
